title: Agent config supply chain scanner
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for scanning repository agent definitions, rule files, MCP configs, and self-editing memory files for hidden Trojan Unicode, unapproved hook or server escalation, built-in name shadowing, and authority spoofing, with tested standard-library Python code.
boundaries: Repository agent, rule, and MCP files are scanned strictly as inert bytes and never executed during inspection.
Any critical or high finding (hidden Trojan/Tag Unicode, shell MCP pipes, permission bypass, hooks, shadowing, or spoofing) sets verdict to block.
Self-edited SOUL.md or memory diffs introducing override claims, shell pipes, hidden Unicode, or external URLs require human approval.
Workers create nouns and propose verbs; importing this pack writes nothing and enqueues nothing.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for defending coding harnesses against repository config supply-chain attacks

value.lets_workers: Inventory agent, rule, MCP, and persona memory files before repository use, detect Rules File Backdoor Unicode smuggling, block unapproved hooks and MCP servers, catch built-in subagent shadowing and authority spoofing, and gate self-editing memory diffs.
value.not_for: Executing untrusted hooks or mutating repository dotfiles automatically.

flow.when: First: scan all discovered agent, rule, and MCP files in the checkout.
Before persisting any self-edited SOUL.md or memory update.
When a scan or memory diff returns block, record a failure tombstone.

nouns.title: Method: inventory inert bytes, scan five threat vectors, and quarantine blocks
nouns.category_reason: Shared defensive inspection pipeline for untrusted repo configs and evolving memory.

lifecycle: scan-repo-agent-configs hashes every harness config file and checks all five supply-chain vectors.
gate-self-editing-memory-diff inspects unified diff additions on SOUL.md or memory files before write persistence.
quarantine-supply-chain-finding records a negative tombstone citing exact file paths and vectors.

nouns.title: Guardrail: scan .claude, .codex, .cursor, .github/agents, .kiro, .opencode, and MCP files as untrusted code

value.rule: Never open or trust a repository's agent or MCP configs in an interactive harness before config_scanner confirms verdict == 'clean'.
value.how_it_is_checked: scan_repository_configs sets verdict='block' on any critical or high finding.

nouns.title: Guardrail: block unreviewed persistence of poisoned self-editing persona memory

value.rule: Self-edited memory additions containing hidden Unicode, authority overrides, shell pipes, or new external URLs set approved_for_auto_persist=false.

nouns.title: Deterministic detection signatures across five agent-config supply-chain vectors

value.unicode_smuggling: Bidi controls (U+202A..U+202E, U+2066..U+2069, U+061C), Unicode Tags (U+E0000..U+E007F with ASCII decode), and mid-file zero-width codepoints.
value.hook_and_mcp_escalation: bypassPermissions/autoApprove flags, PreToolUse/PostToolUse/SessionStart hooks, shell-pipe MCP commands, and unpinned npx -y installs.
value.shadowing_and_spoofing: Reserved slugs (explore, plan, general-purpose, bash, default, self, research, main) and CEO/CISO/override authority claims.

nouns.title: Template: repository agent-config supply-chain scan report

value.describes: scanned config count, inventory SHA-256, verdict, and vector findings

nouns.title: Template: self-editing persona memory diff gate receipt

value.describes: before/after SHA-256 digests, added line count, and auto-persist approval flag
a blocked repository config or poisoned memory update recorded as a tombstone

nouns.title: Deterministic checks for agent-config supply-chain scan reports

value.purpose: Deterministic checks every agent config supply-chain scan report must satisfy.

deterministic_checks.why: Every scan report pins the SHA-256 digest of the discovered config file inventory.
verdict must be clean, review, or block.
Blocked scans must list at least one finding with vector, severity, and file path.
Synthetic scan fixtures must reference local paths or .invalid domains only.

nouns.title: Tool card: config_scanner standard-library CLI and library

value.name: config_scanner
value.runtime: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only.
does: Detects hidden Unicode Tag/bidi/zero-width injection, unapproved hooks, MCP shell escalation, name shadowing, and authority spoofing.
Diff-gates self-editing SOUL.md and memory files before persistence.
does_not: Execute discovered hooks or MCP servers, open network sockets, or modify repository files.

nouns.title: Boucher & Anderson (arXiv:2111.00169): Trojan Source Invisible Vulnerabilities

value.provides: Bidirectional and invisible Unicode codepoint mechanics behind hidden source and rule-file attacks.

nouns.title: NIST NVD CVE-2025-54135: Unapproved MCP configuration command execution

value.provides: Advisory detailing prompt-injected creation or mutation of harness MCP configuration files.

nouns.title: Unicode Technical Report #36: Unicode Security Considerations

value.provides: Default-ignorable, tag, and non-visual codepoint classifications for security scanners.

nouns.title: Worked example: synthetic blocked scan catching Unicode Tag smuggling and MCP shell pipe

value.shows: A repository checkout blocked before interactive harness load due to hidden Unicode Tag characters and a shell-piped MCP server.

verbs.title: Inventory and scan repository agent, rule, and MCP files across five vectors
verbs.summary: Run config_scanner scan on a local checkout to detect hidden Unicode, permission bypasses, lifecycle hooks, unapproved MCP servers, shadowing, and authority spoofing.
verbs.outcome: A checked supply-chain scan report with clean, review, or block verdict.
network: Reads discovered config files as inert bytes inside the local checkout.
steps: Run python3 -m config_scanner scan on the local repository directory without executing any hooks or servers.
Verify the output passes scanner-checks before returning.

verbs.title: Audit self-edited SOUL.md or persona memory diffs before persistence
verbs.summary: Run config_scanner diff-memory on baseline and candidate persona memory text to block silent override directives, shell snippets, hidden Unicode, or new external URLs.
verbs.outcome: A memory diff receipt recording approved_for_auto_persist.

slots.name: memory_pair
slots.description: Local baseline and candidate persona memory files.

network: Reads only the local baseline and candidate memory files.
steps: Run python3 -m config_scanner diff-memory on the before and after files.
Ensure approved_for_auto_persist is false whenever any risk vector appears in added lines.

acceptance.check: Both before_sha256 and after_sha256 are 64-hex digests.

verbs.title: Record a failure tombstone for a blocked repository config or memory diff
verbs.summary: Convert a blocked supply-chain scan report into a reusable failure tombstone naming the inventory digest, vectors, and remediation requirement.

slots.name: scan_report
slots.description: Pin of a blocked config scan report.

steps: Verify the pinned scan_report has verdict 'block' and non-empty findings.
Record inventory_sha256, unique blocked_vectors, and a concrete remediation_rule.

acceptance.check: blocked_vectors contains every unique vector from findings.
